protocol.fit: Separate BO3/BO5 ElasticNet alpha=.08 l1_ratio=.2; five expanding chronological folds; at least 500 training matches and 150 calibration residuals
protocol.eligibility: Common complete predictor universe; 10 prior matches, 5 surface matches, all point statistics in last 25 observed matches, latest match within 45 days
protocol.timing: Capture and archive both before scheduled start; archive within 30 minutes of capture; earlier UTC days only
protocol.availability: Corrected historical records, original publication timestamps unavailable; retrospective only
protocol.primary_probability_sample: One paired line per match: earliest eligible capture, closest no-vig probability to 50%, observation ID tie-break
protocol.bet_selection: Production thresholds unchanged; first qualifying capture, maximum conservative EV, at most one selection per match per candidate
protocol.settlement: Two agreeing sources and conventional completed score for reported metrics; all other outcomes remain separately unresolved
protocol.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap by match for primary probabilities and by UTC capture week for pick ROI; descriptive, not multiple-search corrected
protocol.costs: Displayed prices; no fill/liquidity proof. Gross ROI and 1% stake-cost sensitivity, not estimated actual fees
protocol.holdout: None: this historical period has already informed development. New prospective data required
protocol.paper_candidate: elo chosen for simplicity before comparison; no automatic winner selection or live promotion
